member.name: T:SMRUCC.genomics.Model.MotifGraph.ProteinStructure.FamilyCluster.BlockLouvain
member.summary:
community detection stage of the streaming pipeline.
edges are read back from disk (they were already persisted by so the FASTA / embedding matrices are never re-materialised) and fed into a . classic Louvain is then run via / "Builder.SolveClusters". the resulting per-row family assignment is streamed to disk keyed by row index, keeping only the assignment array (one integer per node) resident instead of any intermediate matrix.
NOTE: the in-memory graph is bounded by the number of nodes (= number of sequences) and the number of edges. for truly massive node counts where the graph itself does not fit in RAM the caller can pre-shard the edge file and run this routine per shard, then merge the communities with the supplied helper. the default path reuses the proven single-graph Louvain which is already a large improvement over the original all-in-memory pipeline that also held every protein sequence string.

member.summary: Extracts kmer features from a protein sequence database and selects a top-N vocabulary used as the fixed dictionary for the TF-IDF vectorization step.
member.remarks:
For each distinct kmer two statistics are collected during a single pass over the sequence database:
the per-document occurrence count (how many times the kmer appears inside a single protein sequence);
the global occurrence count (the total number of times the kmer appears across the whole database).
The kmers are then ranked (by default in ascending order of the chosen metric) and the top-N kmers are kept as the fixed vocabulary.

member.name: T:SMRUCC.genomics.Model.MotifGraph.ProteinStructure.FamilyCluster.StreamingClustering
member.summary:
streaming orchestrator for the unsupervised protein-family clustering pipeline.
the algorithm keeps the same semantics as but never holds the whole database in memory. it runs in two passes over the FASTA file plus a set of on-disk intermediate products:
pass 1a : stream the FASTA once to count kmers and select the top-N vocabulary (memory ~ vocabulary size). pass 1b : stream the FASTA a second time, compute each sequence's TF-IDF sparse vector over the fixed vocabulary and append it to a COO file on disk. pass 2a : stream the COO rows in blocks, reduce with randomized SVD, write m x dims embeddings to disk. pass 2b : stream the embeddings in blocks, build an approximate KNN graph, write undirected edges to disk. pass 2c : read the edges back, run Louvain, write the per-row family assignment to disk. pass 2d : stream the original FASTA once, bucket each member sequence into a per-family FASTA file on disk, then run CenterStar MSA per family (only one family resident at a time) and pick the least-edited reference.
every intermediate file lives under and is reused when present so a failed run can be resumed instead of restarted.

member.name: T:SMRUCC.genomics.Model.MotifGraph.ProteinStructure.FamilyCluster.SvdBlockReducer
member.summary:
block-wise randomized SVD reducer for the streaming pipeline.
the COO sparse vectors are read one block at a time, accumulated into a (row-dictionary layout, so only the current block is ever in memory) and reduced with . the resulting m x k dense embedding is streamed straight to disk row-by-row, so the full embedding never has to be materialized as one big array.
